decisions.reason: This specialized spraying system remains closely tied to the firm's coating and application know-how, and the firm's in-house R&D and research links give it ample capacity to learn from field use and improve rather than exit it.

The low-pressure injection pump is a very close extension of existing pumping and injection capabilities, so it can be supported efficiently within the firm's established engineering and service routines.

A multi-model transfer pump line fits directly into the firm's broad material-handling portfolio and benefits from its strong absorptive capacity in adjacent component, process, and customer-application knowledge.

Although flow monitoring is somewhat more digital and system-oriented than the firm's traditional hardware base, it still leverages installed-equipment knowledge and aligns with the firm's push toward interoperable customer solutions.

The hydraulic two-component spraying system is a close technological neighbor to the firm's core spraying business, and the firm's internal development capabilities make continued refinement more likely than withdrawal after an early launch.
